title: decode.rs: get() closure dual-condition needs comment
description: decode.rs:222: get() closure has two conditions (idx < payload.len() && base+i < encoded_needed) with no comment explaining why both are needed. They serve different purposes: first guards short/truncated lines, second prevents reading past the declared encoded region. Add a brief comment to prevent future simplification.
close_reason: Fixed: added comment explaining both conditions in get() closure.
